chevrusa.title: Chevrusa
chevrusa.subtitle: One partner, one masechet, each of you learning when the day allows.
chevrusa.factInviteHead: Invite by email, and you are set
chevrusa.factInviteBody: Once they accept, they see your progress on the masechet and you see theirs.
chevrusa.factDotsHead: A dot for each day you learn
chevrusa.factDotsBody: Enough to know your chevrusa is in it with you.
chevrusa.factNudgeBody: One tap sends chizuk. Adding a sentence of your own is usually the part that lands.
chevrusa.nudgeText: Perek beis is where it clicks. Worth pushing through.
chevrusa.factNotesBody: Every note carries whose it is. Edit your own, reply under either.
chevrusa.noteBody: The three watches are the key to the whole sugya.
chevrusa.noteReply: That framing helped — I had it as one list.
chevrusa.createSubtitle: Pick the masechet and send one invitation. They see your progress on it once they accept.
chevrusa.sendNote: One invitation, and nothing sent to anyone else.
chevrusa.yoursEmpty: Not paired with anyone yet. Each pairing you make will show its own masechet here.

chabura.title: Chabura

about.title: About Chaburos
about.lead: A chabura is a group of any size learning one masechet together — with your shiur or class, or among friends. Starting one with your shiur or class makes you its rebbe automatically; everyone else who joins is a talmid.
about.classInText: Share the join code shown on your Dashboard, or invite students by email from here.
about.quietText: Your Dashboard (in the sidebar once you have a class) lists students quietest-first, so you always know who to check on. Switch to Grid for the whole shiur at a glance, or export it as a CSV.
about.sendOnlyText: You see a student's daily report — what they learned and where. Their own notes and concepts stay theirs.
about.asUsualText: Daily Limmud, Mishna Quiz, any of the Practice games — nothing about how you learn changes.
about.oneTapText: Home shows a "Today's learning" card summarizing what you've done, with a button to send it to your rebbe. One send a day — keep learning after, and sending again updates it.
about.justYouText: Classmates never see your report, and you never see theirs.
about.chevrusaInstead: Looking to pair with one study partner instead, no group or rebbe? That's Chevrusa.

kind.shiurNote: your rebbe adds you, you send your day in

signedOut.shiurStandfirst: Your shiur or class on one masechet, with each day's learning sent in.
signedOut.shiurNudgeText: Saw you sent four yesterday. Keep it going.
signedOut.shiurGateHeading: Your rebbe adds you to the chabura
signedOut.shiurGateBody: Sign in with the email he has for you and it will be waiting here.
signedOut.friendsStandfirst: A few friends on one masechet, with everyone in it having the same say.
signedOut.friendsNudgeText: Two perakim left in Shabbat. Finish it with us.
signedOut.factMasechetBody: He opens the chabura and adds the talmidim; you appear in it as soon as he does.
signedOut.factSendBody: The day is already listed before you press anything — the limmud, the quiz, whichever games you played.
signedOut.factRowHead: He sees one row per talmid
signedOut.factRowBody: Your day beside every other name in the shiur, at a glance.
signedOut.factRebbeNudgeHead: A nudge, with a line if he wants one
signedOut.factRebbeNudgeBody: A short word of chizuk on the days it helps, with his own sentence added.
signedOut.factInviteBody: Everyone in it has the same say — bring in whoever you like, step out freely whenever you need to.
signedOut.factDotsHead: A dot for each day someone learns
signedOut.factDotsBody: More names than a chevrusa, and the same easy signal for each of them.
signedOut.factNudgeBody: One tap sends chizuk to anyone in the chabura, with a sentence of your own.
signedOut.factNotesBody: Every note carries whose it is. Edit your own, reply under anyone's.
signedOut.noteBody: Learn the 39 in their groups — the eleven of bread first.
signedOut.noteReply: Second group is the eleven of a garment.
